lesson: Two pipeline faults found, not changed. merge_outcomes.py maps precise-obstruction to closed without reading refereeHolds, so the rerun turned two round-6 entries the learn step had set to open into closed. map-open-1 is an open device the generator cannot use: seven closed outcome entries list it as their only node, so every candidate containing it is rejected (this predates the rerun). Of the three new device nodes only landau-siegel-2026-mechanism reaches the top 60. The map parser rejects row ids like A3-C1; they were entered as G27 to G30.
